Wine Name: Barbera D'Asti, Cipressi Nizza, Michele Chiarlo, Piemonte
Tannin Characteristics: Fresh softness with savory, round flavor
Body Characteristics: Full, well-structured, harmonious with an impressive freshness and soft roundness
Finish Characteristics: Savory and round, lingering with freshness
Aroma: Violet, blackberries, raspberries, and sweet spice
Flavor: Bright fruit with blackberries, raspberries, floral hints, and soft spice
Vinification: 10–12 days maceration in steel with soft cap wetting; malolactic fermentation in steel
Maturation: Minimum 18 months; aged 12 months in large oak casks, then bottle refined
General Recommended Accompanies: Cured meats, pasta with meat sauce, risotto, fillet, guinea fowl, medium-aged goat cheeses
Stella Recommended: Gnocchi di Patate “Nonna Nilla” (Italian sausage and porcini ragu), Rigatoni al Ragu di Maiale, Filetto
Summary: **Cipressi Nizza** by **Michele Chiarlo** is a powerful and harmonious **Barbera** from **Piemonte**, grown on calcareous marl and sandy soils in Castelnuovo Calcea. Aged 12 months in large oak casks, this **ruby red** wine reveals aromas of **violet, blackberry, raspberry**, and **sweet spice**, with a palate that is **structured, fresh, and savory**.
Unique Summary: From a top Barbera site in Nizza DOCG, this wine balances richness with elegance and spice.
Sustainability: Manual harvest and yield control; vineyard cultivated with Guyot and low spurred cordon, aiming for low yield and optimal ripeness

Reviews.description: A restrained barbera with aromas of vibrant black cherries, licorice and smoke. Bright fruitiness on the palate, with a medium body, velvety tannins and crisp, persistent acidity. Savory finish. Drink or hold.

The 2022 Nizza Cipressi is packed with inky dark fruit, licorice, new leather and chocolate. Plush, succulent contours wrap it all together. Drink this dense, opulent Barbera over the next handful of years.
Piercing scents of cherry, boysenberry, plum,fruit cake and spices herald this vibrant, crunchy red. Harmonious and firms up on the lingering finish. A Barbera for the table.

Tannin Characteristics: Soft and well-integrated with a smooth grip
Body Characteristics: Fresh and elegant with lively structure and balanced weight
Finish Characteristics: Clean and persistent with subtle spicy notes
Aroma: Fragrant with fresh red fruit and delicate spicy nuances
Flavor: Bright red berries with refreshing acidity and gentle spice
Vinification: Fermented for 12 days at controlled low temperatures (24–28°C) followed by soft pressing. 70% aged in stainless steel and 30% aged in large Slavonian oak casks.
Maturation: 10 months aging (70% stainless steel, 30% Slavonian oak) followed by 6 months bottle refinement.
Type of cask: Large Slavonian oak casks and stainless steel tanks
Vineyard: Langhe area, east/north-east exposure; calcareous and clayey marl soils
Summary: This 100% Barbera from the Langhe area of Piemonte is crafted using a traditional split aging method in stainless steel and large Slavonian oak. The process preserves its fresh acidity and vibrant red fruit character, complemented by subtle spicy notes. Elegant, fragrant, and easy to drink, it reflects the classic expression of Barbera d’Alba.
Unique Summary: A traditional split-aging approach preserves the wine’s vivid acidity while adding subtle spice, creating a balanced and approachable Barbera.

Reviews.description: A very pretty and intense barbera with crushed berries and lots of citrus character. It’s full and layered.

Tannin Characteristics: Velvety and firm with polyphenolic maturity
Body Characteristics: Full-bodied and balanced with elegant texture and a persistent finish
Finish Characteristics: Persistent with spice and red fruit tones
Aroma: Complex aromas of red fruit and spice
Flavor: Elegant expression of Nebbiolo with red fruit, spice, and soft oak integration
Vinification: Destemmed and crushed, maceration on skins for 8 days (max 30°C), malolactic fermentation completed before winter
Maturation: Aged approximately one year in large oak barrels of varying capacities
Vineyard: Vineyards in Treiso and Neive, Barbaresco area
General Recommended Accompanies: Ideal with grilled meats, aged cheeses, pasta with truffle or rich sauces
Stella Recommended: Osso Buco di Vitello, Scottadito di Agnello, Filetto
Summary: **Prunotto Barbaresco 2021** showcases the elegant structure of **Nebbiolo** from **Treiso and Neive**, aged in large oak barrels for softness and balance. This **garnet red** wine features **red fruit, spice**, and a **velvety, full-bodied** palate with a persistent finish.
Unique Summary: Elegant yet powerful Barbaresco that balances Nebbiolo’s finesse with structure, aged in oak for one year.

Reviews.description: An overt style, the candied nose showing red fruits, raspberries, roses and a touch of gingerbread. Sweet and medium-bodied on the palate, this has refreshing acidity and velvety tannins that turn dustier in the savory finish. Try from 2026.

A translucent medium ruby hue, the 2022 Barbaresco is zesty and spicy on the nose with forward notes of anise, orange zest, fresh mint, cranberry, and dried earth. The palate shows the fruity and sunny side of the vintage, and it’s medium-framed and light on its feet, with a clean and easygoing feel. It’s not the most profound wine, but it offers a lot of immediate appeal. Drink 2025-2032.

Tannin Characteristics: Soft tannins with structure and balance, offering long aging potential
Body Characteristics: Excellent structure, harmony, and elegance with balanced fruit and a classic style
Finish Characteristics: Persistent and structured with balanced fruit and tannin integration
Aroma: Not specified; expected complex red fruit, earth, spice and floral notes from multiple terroirs
Flavor: Classic Barolo profile with fruit, earth, soft tannins, and oak integration
Vinification: Fermented in stainless steel with 25–30 days maceration and skin contact
Maturation: Aged 30 months in large French oak botti, with a small portion in barriques
Type of cask: Large French oak botti and some barriques
Color: Not specified; typically garnet red with brick hues over time
Vineyard: Multiple family-owned vineyards: Serralunga d’Alba, Grinzane Cavour, La Morra, Novello, Monforte
General Recommended Accompanies: Rich meats, truffle dishes, aged cheeses, braised beef
Stella Recommended: Osso Buco di Vitello, Scottadito di Agnello, Spezzatino al Barolo
Summary: **Pio Cesare Barolo 2019** is a **classic and structured Barolo** crafted from top vineyards across Serralunga, La Morra, and Monforte. Aged 30 months in large oak, it offers **elegance, soft tannins, and long aging potential**. This DOCG wine captures the essence of multiple Barolo terroirs.
Unique Summary: Produced using a traditional multi-vineyard Barolo formula, this wine offers a harmonious blend of structure and finesse.

Reviews.description: Pio Cesare does a great job with its classic 2019 Barolo (in production since 1881). The bottom of the front label reads "Barolo Pio" in memory of the legendary Pio Boffa. He was a wine entrepreneur who gained the immediate respect and love of all those who knew him. He passed away tragically during the COVID-19 pandemic just as the vaccines were being rolled out. This is a large production of about 70,000 bottles with fruit sourced from across seven vineyards in five villages. Despite those ambitious numbers, the wine remains strictly focused on bright Nebbiolo fruit with red cassis and aniseed. The finish is smooth with tannins that elegantly dissolve over the palate.

Lovely perfumes of flowers, fresh strawberries and raspberries follow through to a medium- to full-bodied palate with fine tannins that run the length of the wine. Citrus and spice undertones. Finishes long and intense. Tannic finish.

A savory version, displaying macerated cherry and currant fruit aligned with eucalyptus, rosemary and earth flavors. Dense and lively, ending with a solid grip of tannins. Fresh and on the austere side. Best from 2026 through 2042. 5,800 cases made, 3,500 cases imported.

A touch more reserved at the moment, the 2019 Barolo reveals notes of pure red fruit, cherry, grenadine, dusty earth, and menthol. It is gripping with structure and rich with tea leaf, cherry, and turned soil. Drink 2024-2035.

Tannin Characteristics: Elegant and structured with tannins suited for long aging
Body Characteristics: Full-bodied and classic with broad aromatic depth and structure
Finish Characteristics: Long, expressive evolution with spice and floral persistence
Aroma: Tempting spice, floral notes, and sweet red fruit
Flavor: Well-structured with spicy and floral nuances, backed by rich fruit and earthy elegance
Vinification: Traditional long fermentation and maceration in oak fermenters at 30°C
Maturation: Up to 30 months in large Slavonian oak casks followed by bottle aging
Vineyard: Multiple vineyard sites across the Barolo region, mixed limestone soils
General Recommended Accompanies: Red meats, game, truffle dishes, fresh egg pasta, risotto, medium-aged cheeses
Stella Recommended: Osso Buco di Vitello, Scottadito di Agnello, Spezzatino al Barolo
Summary: **Massolino Barolo 2019** is a **classic Barolo** crafted with traditional methods and long aging in **Slavonian oak**. It offers an expressive **bouquet of spice, floral, and fruit notes**, with a **full body** and elegant tannins perfect for aging. A true tribute to the terroirs of Serralunga and beyond.
Unique Summary: Traditional Barolo with 30-month oak aging, offering broad aromatics and expressive structure from multiple vineyard sites.
Sustainability: Sustainable and vegan practicing vineyards with traditional vinification

Reviews.description: Bright and lively red fruit character with dried flowers, stones and hints of tree resin. Medium-bodied, clean and focused on the palate, with fine tannins and a linear finish.

Showing elegant richness and a velvety consistency, the Massolino 2020 Barolo ages in large oak botti for 30 months. The wine represents a blend of fruit from Serralunga d'Alba (Collaretto, Briccolina, Broglio and Le Turne) and one site in Castiglione Falletto. Elegance is underlined in this wine that shows wild berry, dried blueberry and a sweet touch of lilac over a medium-dark finish. The wine's texture manages to be direct and linear but generous at the same time.

Opening with aromas of crushed red fruits and a bouquet of bay leaf, balsam and sandalwood that slowly lift from the glass. The palate is rounded and pretty—soft tannins make it immediately accessible.

Cherry, plum, camphor and tobacco flavors are aligned with a silky texture. This intense red is juicy midpalate before building to the long finish, with earth, tobacco and licorice notes. Still, this is solid and dense.

Medium red in color, the 2020 Barolo is fruity and expressive out of the gate, with pure, ripe aromas of ripe mixed berries, wildflowers, sweet herbs, and cedar. There’s lovely freshness on the palate, with medium body, mouthwatering dark mineral accents, ripe tannins, and an approachable feel. It’s a very appealing wine that captures the elements of this vintage with a skillful hand. Drink 2024-2032.

Tannin Characteristics: Noble, balanced tannins with subtle persistence
Body Characteristics: Elegant and refined with a delicate transparency and long, mineral finish
Finish Characteristics: Subtle, mineral, and persistent with floral and iron hints
Aroma: Violet, rose petals, spice, balsamic, small red fruits
Flavor: Red fruit jelly, floral notes, spice, balsamic herbs, and minerality
Vinification: Not specified in the sheet, traditional for Nebbiolo wines from Gattinara
Maturation: Not detailed; traditionally aged in oak and bottle before release
Color: Vintage and bright ruby red with delicate transparency
General Recommended Accompanies: Red meats, game, aged cheese, risotto, and truffle dishes
Stella Recommended: Osso Buco di Vitello, Scottadito di Agnello, Spezzatino al Barolo
Summary: **Travaglini Gattinara 2020** is a classic expression of **Nebbiolo** from northern Piemonte, delivering elegant **floral and spicy aromatics**, with refined **tannins**, vibrant acidity, and a **mineral-driven finish**. A wine of heritage and subtle complexity from volcanic soils.
Unique Summary: Known for its iconic bottle and mineral-laced Nebbiolo, Travaglini Gattinara showcases floral elegance and volcanic finesse.

Reviews.description: A restrained and smoky wine with a lot of freshness, showing aromas of potpourri, wild strawberries, citrus leaves and stony minerality. Full-bodied, it shows the firmness of nebbiolo well balanced by fruit concentration, refreshing acidity and a savory finish. Precise and balanced.
The 2021 Gattinara is bright and punchy. A fine introduction to the range, the 2021 possesses notable depth. There is a bit of angularity in the tannins. This is far from an easygoing wine.

Vanilla, Bourbon and toasty oak accents frame cherry and strawberry flavors in this racy red. Underscored by eucalyptus and mineral notes, ending with a grip of chewy tannins. Give this time to absorb the oak. Best from 2027 through 2038,

Wine Name: Brunello di Montalcino “Pian Delle Vigne”, Antinori, Toscana
Tannin Characteristics: Silky, elegant tannins with freshness and savory texture
Body Characteristics: Vibrant, savory, and elegant with fresh acidity and layered fruit
Finish Characteristics: Persistent with citrus, vanilla, and delicate spice
Aroma: Cherries, black cherries, blood orange, violets, vanilla, balsamic
Flavor: Fresh red fruit, citrus, subtle spice, vanilla, and savory elegance
Vinification: 12-day maceration in stainless steel at 28°C; malolactic fermentation followed by 2 years in large oak barrels
Maturation: Aged 2 years in large oak barrels (30–80hl), followed by bottle aging
Vineyard: Estate vineyards 6 km southwest of Montalcino, 130m elevation, southwest exposure
General Recommended Accompanies: Red meats, braised meats, lasagna, aged cheeses, rich pasta dishes
Stella Recommended: Osso Buco, Spezzatino, Lasagna Filetto Bolognese
Summary: **Pian delle Vigne Brunello di Montalcino 2019** by **Antinori** expresses the elegance of **Sangiovese** from the southwest hills of Montalcino. Aged in large oak for two years, it delivers **silky tannins**, layered aromas of **cherry, citrus, violet**, and spice with a long, savory finish.
Unique Summary: Antinori’s Brunello highlights a vibrant, structured Sangiovese aged in large oak for finesse and longevity.

Reviews.description: A complex red with floral, lemon-rind and candied-cherry character. It’s medium-bodied with juicy fruit, as well as plenty of dried citrus rind. Some sandalwood and dried-flower undertones, too.

Dried black cherries and crushed plums mix with cocoa, sage and dried orange peels as the 2020 Brunello di Montalcino emerges from the glass. This displays incredible vibrancy within. It’s juicy and spry, with ripe red and black fruits elevated by brilliant acidity as nuances of sour citrus add further tension toward the close. The 2020 leaves the palate stained in primary concentration and a coating of fine tannins, tapering off spicy and long yet still lively as hints of tart raspberry keep the mouth watering for more. Recent vintages from Pian delle Vigne have delightful new energy and verve.

This red features an alluring mix of strawberry and cherry fruit combined with tomato leaf, eucalyptus and cast iron. Builds nicely on the palate to the long, complex finish. Dry, dusty tannins linger, along with fruity and savory echoes. Best from 2027 through 2043.

The 2020 Brunello Di Montalcino pours a saturated magenta/red color and is generous on the nose with notes of mixed berry compote, licorice candies, leather, and mocha. It fills the palate and has well-defined broad shoulders, with chalky tannins and a grounding mineral texture. A red consistent with what lovers of these wines can expect, it should have another 10 years ahead.

Blend: Predominantly Sangiovese with small percentages of Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc
Tannin Characteristics: Supple and vibrant with structure and finesse
Body Characteristics: Rich, sophisticated, and intense with aromatic depth and balanced structure
Finish Characteristics: Persistent with notes of fruit, chocolate, tobacco, and licorice
Aroma: Ripe plum, blackberry, candied orange peel, dark chocolate, caramel, licorice, sweet tobacco
Flavor: Intense dark fruit, orange peel, chocolate, licorice, and sweet tobacco
Vinification: Fermented in conical tanks with extended skin maceration.
Maturation: 15 months in predominantly new French and Hungarian oak, then 12 months in bottle
Type of cask: Predominantly new French and Hungarian oak barrels
Color: Ruby red with intense purple hues
Vineyard: Tignanello estate vineyard (140 acres), limestone-rich soil, 350–400m elevation
General Recommended Accompanies: Braised meat, filet, Bolognese pasta, aged cheeses, structured stews
Summary: **Tignanello 2021** is a benchmark **Super Tuscan** showcasing a blend of **Sangiovese, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Cabernet Franc** from Antinori’s limestone-rich vineyard. Aged in new oak and bottle, it delivers a **sophisticated palate** of dark fruit, chocolate, licorice, and tobacco with a **long, vibrant finish**.
Unique Summary: Iconic Super Tuscan—pioneering Sangiovese-Cabernet blend aged in new oak, rich with complexity and finesse.

Reviews.description: Rich and fruit-forward, the Marchesi Antinori 2022 Tignanello very much respects the vintage that tends to deliver more concentration and volume overall. It delivers extra fruit weight with a velvety, satiny feel over a generous mouthfeel. Tignanello offers blackcurrant and cherry, but there is a mineral note that keeps things focused. This is a beautiful expression of the vintage, with excellent work done to execute soft tannins, texture and length.

There’s extraordinary energy in this wine. It displays a dark nose of black cherries, bramble fruit, violets, forest, licorice, bark, carob and leather. Density and tension dominate the full-bodied palate, with firm, velvety tannins. It’s slightly austere in the finish at the moment, yet it’s crunchy and full of potential.

Tignanello in 2022 is a blend of 78% Sangiovese, 18% Cabernet Sauvignon and 4% Cabernet Franc. Pot-pourri-infused red and black berry aromas introduce a succulent palate of good intensity. It's well balanced and bright, with cashmere tannins supporting a core of sapid hedgerow berries outlined by crushed rock minerality and bitter herbs. The finish is slightly disjointed, displaying a touch of alcohol warmth and wood which is yet to fully integrate, but given time it should come good.

The 2022 Tignanello is such an elegant, poised wine. Brisk acids cut through a core of red Sangiovese fruit. Crushed flowers, mint, cinnamon, rose petal and a kiss of French oak appear later, adding notable brightness. The 2022 is a decidedly mid-weight Tignanello, but all the elements are very nicely balanced throughout. Tignanello saw rain episodes at the end of the season, like most properties, but steep, well-draining hillsides were a clear advantage. The blend is 78% Sangiovese, 18% Cabernet Sauvignon and 4% Cabernet Franc, essentially the classic proportions here.

The rich texture wraps around plum, cherry, graphite, tobacco and earth flavors, with a line of dusty tannins underneath. Fresh, elegant and long, ending with a pleasant astringency. Give this a year or two to integrate. Sangiovese, Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc. Best from 2027 through 2040.

Wine Name: Vino Nobile di Montepulciano, Poliziano, Toscana
Tannin Characteristics: Structured and balanced from a blend of traditional Tuscan grapes
Body Characteristics: Elegant and complex with depth from oak aging and varietal blend
Finish Characteristics: Refined and persistent, supported by acidity and layered fruit
Aroma: Not explicitly listed; expected red berries, spice, floral notes from Prugnolo Gentile
Flavor: Elegant with depth, color, and complexity; likely red fruit, spice, and oak
Vinification: Fermented in French oak vats using vineyard-selected yeast; optical grape sorting
Maturation: Aged 18–20 months: 20% in barriques, 40% in tonneaux, 40% in large casks (all French oak), then 6–8 months in bottle
Type of cask: French oak (barriques, tonneaux, and large casks)
Color: Not specified; typically deep ruby with garnet highlights
Vineyard: Commune of Montepulciano, 300–420m elevation, clay/silt soils with fossils
General Recommended Accompanies: Red meats, roasts, traditional Tuscan dishes, aged cheeses
Stella Recommended: Filetto, Rigatoni al Ragu, Maiale with pancetta and aglio
Summary: **Poliziano Vino Nobile di Montepulciano 2021** blends **85% Sangiovese** with traditional Tuscan varieties to deliver an **elegant and structured red** aged in various French oak formats. Sustainable and expressive, this DOCG wine shows the depth and nobility of Montepulciano terroir.
Unique Summary: Crafted from high-altitude vineyards with fossil-rich soils, this wine blends tradition and elegance with modern oak aging.
Sustainability: Sustainably farmed; optical sorting and French oak aging

Reviews.description: The 2022 Poliziano Vino Nobile di Montepulciano exhibits a deep garnet-black color and presents aromas of smoky oak, toast, and vibrant red and black fruits. Full-bodied and densely packed, the palate is elevated by ripe blackberries and layers of spicy oak. Bold and structured, this wine pairs perfectly with Lomo Saltado. In this iconic Peruvian beef stir-fry, its richness and savory spice beautifully complement the dish’s bold flavors and seared textures. (Tasted: July 18, 2025, San Francisco, CA)

Tannin Characteristics: Soft, supple, and gently sweet tannins
Body Characteristics: Lively and dynamic structure with a juicy and energetic mid-palate
Finish Characteristics: Savory and persistent with smooth tannins
Aroma: Fresh cherry, raspberry, pomegranate with violet and floral notes
Flavor: Juicy red berries, cherry, raspberry jelly, pomegranate with savory undertones
Vinification: Each variety was fermented separately in stainless steel at controlled temperatures (26–28°C) with 10–14 days maceration to extract soft tannins, followed by malolactic fermentation and blending
Maturation: Aged in large Slavonian oak barrels with a small portion in barriques and stainless steel vats
Type of cask: Slavonian oak, barrique, and stainless steel
Summary: This Chianti Classico from Antinori highlights vibrant Sangiovese fruit with notes of cherry, raspberry, and pomegranate layered with floral aromatics. Crafted through careful vinification and aging in Slavonian oak, it delivers a balanced, juicy palate with soft tannins and a long savory finish that reflects the elegance of Tuscany.
Unique Summary: A classic Chianti Classico showcasing bright fruit purity, floral lift, and smooth, approachable tannins.

Reviews.description: On the nose, savory top soil, espresso and black pepper balance blackberries and black cherries. The cohesive palate is simultaneously spicy and dense with ripe but still tart and snappy fruit, and has a finish of spicy pepper, earth and a bit of bitter citrus pith.

The Marchesi Antinori 2023 Chianti Classico Pèppoli comes from a vintage with heat and rain that ultimately made for fresher wines compared to the darker and more concentrated wines from 2022. This versatile red wine shows aromas of cassis, cherry and orange peel. Sangiovese is blended with small percentages of Canaiolo, Cabernet Sauvignon or Merlot, depending on the year. The bouquet focuses nicely on red fruits, but there is a hint of sweet ripeness as well.

There’s depth and breadth to this solidly built red, along with black cherry, blackberry, earth and iron flavors. Juicy and well-structured, with a fresh feel on the lingering finish. Sangiovese, Merlot and Syrah.

Wine Name: Chianti Classico Riserva, Villa Antinori, Toscana
Tannin Characteristics: Silky, supple and well-integrated with refined structure
Body Characteristics: Full and enveloping on the entry with balanced structure and elegant vertical lift
Finish Characteristics: Long, refined finish marked by delicate rose petal and black tea notes
Aroma: Blackberry, medlar jam, raspberry jelly with notes of tobacco, sweet licorice, candied citrus and cocoa powder
Flavor: Dark berry compote, subtle tobacco, sweet spice and cocoa with floral and tea nuances
Vinification: Destemmed and gently crushed grapes fermented in stainless steel at controlled temperatures of 28–30°C. Maceration lasted approximately 10–14 days with gentle extraction techniques. Sangiovese completed malolactic fermentation in stainless steel, while complementary varieties partially aged in barriques before final blending.
Maturation: Aged predominantly in larger oak barrels with a smaller percentage in barriques until spring 2024 before bottling in July 2024.
Type of cask: Large oak barrels and barriques (second and third fill)
Summary: Villa Antinori Chianti Classico Riserva 2022 is a historic Tuscan expression crafted from predominantly Sangiovese, offering layered aromas of blackberry, raspberry, tobacco, and cocoa. Silky tannins frame a balanced and structured palate that unfolds into a long, refined finish with notes of rose petal and black tea. Aged primarily in large oak barrels, this DOCG Riserva reflects both tradition and modern elegance.
Unique Summary: A refined and historic Chianti Classico Riserva that balances silky tannins, vibrant berry fruit, and elegant oak aging in true Antinori tradition.

Reviews.description: A youthful wine full of fruit, showing intense fresh roses, black cherries and plums. The generous nose is supported by a lush, supple palate with medium body. Velvety tannins with a chalkier finish and refreshing length.

Showing a soothing dark color and rich concentration, the Marchesi Antinori 2022 Chianti Classico Riserva Villa Antinori draws its fruit from across the appellation. This is a silky, satiny wine with good fruit and dimension and an accessible personality. It closes with sweet tannins and a hint of elegant chalkiness for good measure.

Tannin Characteristics: Soft and elegant with subtle oak influence
Body Characteristics: Refined structure with balance and varietal purity
Finish Characteristics: Clean with hints of wood, fruit, and freshness
Aroma: Primary aromas preserved from high-altitude Nero d’Avola fruit
Flavor: Red fruit purity with subtle oak and smooth tannins
Vinification: Fermented in stainless steel at 25–28°C with 12-day maceration and full malolactic fermentation
Maturation: Aged 12 months in 225L French oak barrels (20% new, 80% used)
Color: Not specified; typically deep ruby red for Nero d’Avola
Vineyard: High hill sites at 450–750 meters above sea level
General Recommended Accompanies: Grilled meats, roasted pork, tomato-based pasta dishes
Stella Recommended: Milanese di Pollo, Maiale con Pancetta e Aglio, Spaghetti Bolognese
Summary: **Lamùri 2022** from **Tenuta Regaleali** is a high-elevation **Nero d’Avola** aged in French oak for 12 months. Expressing **pure red fruit, elegant tannins**, and Sicilian character, it’s a balanced wine with subtle wood tones and vibrant acidity.
Unique Summary: Named after the Sicilian word for love, this wine highlights Nero d'Avola’s finesse from cooler, high-altitude vineyards.
Sustainability: Grapes grown at high elevations for natural freshness; aged with minimal oak impact

Reviews.description: TNotes of tarragon and thyme weave through flavors of juicy black plum, gaining a dark chocolate richness while maintaining a firm, lively structure. This is a delicious and versatile introduction to nero d’Avola.

Here's a classic expression of Sicily's number one indigenous grape. The Tasca Conti d'Almerita 2019 Sicilia Nero d’Avola Lamùri Tenuta Regaleali offers plenty of dark fruit intensity and toasted pistachio nut, wild fennel and scorched earth. This is your quintessential pasta and meat ragù wine, thanks to its freshness and accessible style.

Tannin Characteristics: Soft and approachable with no oak influence, emphasizing fruit purity
Body Characteristics: Bright, fruit-forward, and smooth due to stainless steel vinification
Finish Characteristics: Clean and juicy with persistent cherry and raspberry
Aroma: Cherries, raspberries, and bright red fruit
Flavor: Bright cherry and raspberry with vibrant fruit character and no oak influence
Vinification: Destemmed and macerated in stainless steel for a few days, fermented for ~8 days, followed by malolactic fermentation
Maturation: Aged in stainless steel to preserve freshness and fruit
Vineyard: South-facing organic vineyards near Pavia with clay and chalky soils
General Recommended Accompanies: All pasta dishes, pizza, barbecue, and ripe cheeses
Summary: **Tiamo's 2023 Barbera** is a **fruit-forward, organically grown Italian red** from Lombardy near the Piedmont border. Aged entirely in **stainless steel**, it delivers **bright cherry and raspberry aromas**, with a smooth body and vibrant acidity. Perfect for everyday enjoyment.
Unique Summary: A stainless-steel aged, organic, and vegan Barbera made without oak to highlight bright fruit purity — ideal for casual Italian fare.
Sustainability: Certified organic, sustainable, eco-friendly practices with USDA 'Made with Organic Grapes' certification

Wine Name: Nebbiolo, Nino Negri, Valtellina Superiore Quadrio, Lombardia
Tannin Characteristics: Elegant, softened by Merlot’s velvety texture
Body Characteristics: Dry, vigorous, and full with finesse and drinkability
Finish Characteristics: Refined, with lingering florals and berry notes
Aroma: Raspberry jam, roses, violets, berry fruit, and a grassy nuance
Flavor: Red berries, floral notes, and savory undertones with fresh tannins
Vinification: 10-day maceration, cold fermentation in stainless steel, matured 18 months in large French and Slavonian oak vats
Maturation: 18 months in large French and Slavonian oak vats
Type of cask: Large French and Slavonian oak vats
Vineyard: South/southeast/southwest-facing terraced slopes, 900–1600 ft elevation, sandy loam soil
Stella Recommended: Milanese di Pollo, Maiale con Pancetta e Aglio, Spaghetti Bolognese
Summary: **Quadrio 2020** by **Nino Negri** is a fresh take on **Nebbiolo** softened by **Merlot**, grown on steep Valtellina terraces and aged in large oak for 18 months. Expect notes of **raspberry jam, roses, violets**, and a **vigorous but refined** palate with floral lift and earthy grace.
Unique Summary: Named for a 15th-century castle, Quadrio blends Nebbiolo power with Merlot softness for a unique and elegant Valtellina DOCG expression.
Sustainability: Terraced vineyards managed with low-yield, high-elevation practices for optimal ripeness and purity

Reviews.description: Savory notes of herbed green olive, smoke and paprika meet dried cherry and pomegranate seed flavors in this bright, medium-bodied red, which is firmed by lightly chewy tannins. Nebbiolo and Merlot. Drink now. 949 cases imported.

Blend: 75% Corvina Veronese and Corvinone Veronese, 25% Rondinella
Wine Name: Amarone della Valpolicella Classico, Giuseppe Campagnola, Veneto
Tannin Characteristics: Round and rich with structure from extended oak aging
Body Characteristics: Full-bodied with intense depth, warmth, and richness
Finish Characteristics: Powerful and persistent with ripe fruit and toasted spice
Aroma: Cherry, ripe plum, toasted almond, vanilla
Flavor: Ripe cherry and plum with almond and vanilla from oak aging
Vinification: Soft pressed in Dec/Jan after drying for 100 days; macerated on skins for 30 days
Maturation: 60% aged 24 months in large oak barrels, 40% aged 18 months in new French barriques, followed by 6 months in bottle
